ablation.donor_rule: manifest val order cyclic successor (i+1)%6, no self; donor frame=current frame; same quantization level; decode each file against its own base identity before exchange
ablation.wrong_source_replacement: swap decoded enhancement symbols/u_hat only; delta is identical; no source-dependent mean/scale/hyperprior exists; keep current ell and q_recon
ablation.zero_rule: zero integers through s.float()*delta and the same D/G; never call no-stream bypass
ablation.continuous_rule: same frozen E on original RGB [0,1] with replicated bottom padding; use pre-division u directly in model units
ablation.metric_deduplication: only exactly equal output tensors for the same source frame may reuse metric results; all requested network forwards still executed

oracle.selection: first, middle, last P frame in each existing Train2 clip; metadata-driven before optimization
oracle.lambda_p_source: V1 training.lambda_p, confirmed active in C/D logs

rate_analysis.all_zero_flag_estimate: retain all existing container/frame headers; add 1 byte per P-frame containing zero flag plus byte alignment; omit complete arithmetic payload for zero grids; estimate only

metrics.implementation: V1 evaluation.py/source src.utils.metrics; same float64 scipy MS-SSIM and PSNR; LPIPS alex v0.1 normalize=True
metrics.quality_mean: equal per-frame means; per-video and aggregate both saved
metrics.norm: L2 and RMS (sqrt mean square); relative L2 = norm(delta)/max(norm(start),1e-12)
